verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for a tax filing and payment portal, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is Webfile's ability to post-date a single electronic check payment, which is a one-off future-dated action, not a recurring schedule. No recurring payment, filing, or workflow scheduler is documented, and probes found no public API or OpenAPI surface to drive one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: you can file your return early and post-date the electronic check payment by changing the payment effective date
